chunks: O believers, when you go out on a journey in the way of God, be discreet and do not say to anyone who greets you in peace: 'You are not a believer.' You desire the gain of earthly life, but there are prizes in plenty with God. You were also like him (an unbeliever) in the past, but God has been gracious to you. So be careful and discreet, for God is aware of what you do.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Tabayyun' in Surah An-Nisa verse 94?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the principle of *tabayyun* (verification) in distinguishing between true believers and those who may be feigning faith for material gain, particularly during the early Islamic conflicts. It highlights the danger of greed (*tabaghur*) leading to hasty judgments, reminding the community that their own transition from disbelief to faith was a divine grace that should foster humility and careful discernment. The verse underscores that ultimate judgment belongs to God, who is fully aware of the intentions behind outward greetings of peace.
